theorem Paper.chain_exists: hypothesis 'h_nodup' 'List.Nodup cs' proved equivalent to formal 'cs.Nodup'
theorem Paper.chain_exists: hypothesis 'h_sub' 'forall c, c ∈ cs -> c ∈ w' proved equivalent to formal 'forall c : nat, c ∈ cs -> c ∈ w'

theorem Paper.chain_exists: conclusion 'exists S : DOL nat, S.start.length = 1 /\ S.derive n = w /\ (forall a, a ∈ S.start -> a ∈ w) /\ forall a, a ∉ w -> S.rule a = [a]' proved equivalent to formal 'exists S : DOL nat, S.start.length = 1 /\ S.derive n = w /\ (forall a : nat, a ∈ S.start -> a ∈ w) /\ forall a : nat, ~a ∈ w -> S.rule a = [a]'

theorem Paper.infer_complete: conclusion 'exists fuel, exists Q, Q ∈ infer sigma B w n fuel /\ canon sigma n Q = canon sigma n P' proved equivalent to formal 'exists fuel : nat, exists Q : Presented nat, Q ∈ infer sigma B w n fuel /\ canon sigma n Q = canon sigma n P'
theorem Paper.infer_sound: hypothesis 'h_sub' 'forall c, c ∈ w -> c ∈ sigma' proved equivalent to formal 'forall c : nat, c ∈ w -> c ∈ sigma'

theorem Paper.infer_sound: conclusion 'exists P, P ∈ sol sigma B w n /\ canon sigma n Q = canon sigma n P' proved equivalent to formal 'exists P : Presented nat, P ∈ sol sigma B w n /\ canon sigma n Q = canon sigma n P'

theorem Paper.unary_iff: conclusion '(exists S : DOL Unit, S.start.length < L /\ S.derive n = List.replicate L ()) <-> exists m, 2 <= m /\ m ^ n ∣ L' proved equivalent to formal '(exists S : DOL Unit, S.start.length < L /\ S.derive n = List.replicate L ()) <-> exists m : nat, 2 <= m /\ m ^ n ∣ L'
theorem Paper.exists_underivable: hypothesis 'h_nodup' 'List.Nodup sigma' proved equivalent to formal 'sigma.Nodup'
theorem Paper.exists_underivable: conclusion 'exists w, w ∈ words sigma L /\ sol sigma B w n = []' proved equivalent to formal 'exists w : List nat, w ∈ words sigma L /\ sol sigma B w n = []'
theorem Paper.exists_incompressible: hypothesis 'h_nodup' 'List.Nodup sigma' proved equivalent to formal 'sigma.Nodup'

theorem Paper.exists_incompressible: conclusion 'exists w, w ∈ words sigma L /\ forall S : DOL nat, (forall x, x ∈ S.start -> x ∈ sigma) -> (forall a, a ∈ sigma -> forall x, x ∈ S.rule a -> x ∈ sigma) -> (forall a, a ∉ sigma -> S.rule a = [a]) -> dsize sigma S <= s -> S.derive n <> w' proved equivalent to formal 'exists w : List nat, w ∈ words sigma L /\ forall S : DOL nat, (forall x : nat, x ∈ S.start -> x ∈ sigma) -> (forall a : nat, a ∈ sigma -> forall x : nat, x ∈ S.rule a -> x ∈ sigma) -> (forall a : nat, ~a ∈ sigma -> S.rule a = [a]) -> dsize sigma S <= s -> S.derive n <> w'
theorem Paper.sharp_implies_insertion: hypothesis 'h_ne' 'forall a, S.rule a <> []' proved equivalent to formal 'forall a : Bool, S.rule a <> []'
theorem Paper.sharp_implies_insertion: hypothesis 'h_both' 'forall c, c ∈ w' proved equivalent to formal 'forall c : Bool, c ∈ w'

theorem Paper.sharp_implies_insertion: conclusion 'exists x p q, S.rule x = [x] /\ S.rule (!x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x /\ 1 <= p + q' proved equivalent to formal 'exists x : Bool, exists p : nat, exists q : nat, S.rule x = [x] /\ (S.rule !x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x /\ 1 <= p + q'

example Paper.sharp_implies_insertion_nonvacuous: conclusion 'exists (S : DOL Bool) (n : nat) (w : List Bool), (forall a, S.rule a <> []) /\ S.derive n = w /\ S.start.length < w.length /\ (forall c, c ∈ w) /\ w.length < sharpT n' proved equivalent to formal 'exists S : DOL Bool, exists n : nat, exists w : List Bool, (forall a : Bool, S.rule a <> []) /\ S.derive n = w /\ S.start.length < w.length /\ (forall c : Bool, c ∈ w) /\ w.length < sharpT n'

theorem Paper.crit_of_insertion: hypothesis 'h_ins' 'S.rule (!x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x' proved equivalent to formal '(S.rule !x) = List.replicate p x ++ (!x) :: List.replicate q x'
